name: ReelDance
tagline: AI image and short-video creation workspace for content creators
description: ReelDance is a browser-based workspace for generating images and short videos with AI. Creators can start with a text prompt to produce a visual or a video, or use an existing image as the starting point for an animated clip. These workflows help prepare visual content for social media without moving between separate image and video generation interfaces. Sign-up includes 5 free credits. On the pricing page checked November 12, 2026, Creator is $29/month or $15/month when $180 is billed yearly, for 500 credits. Pro is $69/month or $34/month when $408 is billed yearly, for 1,500 credits. Studio is $159/month or $99/month when $1,188 is billed yearly, for 4,000 credits. Monthly credits do not roll over. This listing is submitted by the authorized ReelDance Assistant and describes the product rather than providing an independent review or a claim about audience growth.
